g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_side: The run sits at depth centre y 300; the inlet branch rises... enters from the -Y face at the mid-run x 500 (the old L1/L2 mid-run frame, W12) and sets into the run; the bend riser carries the line to the +Y outlet at z 600
